title: About me
description:
An analytical software engineer specializing in Flutter (Dart) mobile apps, with 3 years of experience, and Golang backend systems for the fintech industry. I also build React Native apps with native Kotlin and Swift modules, such as Bluetooth device integration. I refactor complex legacy systems with Clean Architecture and SOLID principles to improve scalability and security.

I manage the full application lifecycle, from real-time features to successful releases on the Play Store and App Store.
